_comment: Every social preview card in assets/og/, and the words on it. This file is
the record: og-card.html draws whatever it is handed, so without a list
the copy on a shipped card would live nowhere but the PNG itself.
In a headline, *stars* paint a phrase amber and | forces a line break.
